fieldValues.title: A decision arises
fieldValues.moved_by: anyone: a builder or reviewer in a PR, the steward in a report, the owner in chat or an issue, a session, an RFC
fieldValues.theory: A decision exists when making a commitment will reduce future options (muDemocracy foundation 4.1). Decisions rarely stand alone: most follow from principles.
gaps: Decisions arise in at least nine places (PR bodies and comments, chat, issues, run reports, sessions, exercises, srs RFCs, srs-rust ADRs, srs-context) and nothing gathers them.

createdBy.name: Claude Code (mapping the flows with the owner, 2026-10-24)
